answer: Agents could earn the right to submit trades only after posting a bond that is slashed when an independent audit proves fraud. Because the bond is locked per identity, creating a hundred accounts requires funding a hundred bonds; it is not enough to mint cheap names. Auditors can select accounts at random and compare signed receipts against counterparties, making each fake identity a separate financial risk. A haven for honest agents may feel like velvet, but no relic of reputation exempts an account from scrutiny.
